variable_coverage.construction: Construct X_i,T as FY1 + FY2, apply LTG to estimate FY3/FY4, add current dividends for periods 1–4 and reinvest at estimated cost of capital; divide by current book value per share B_i,0. Post-release forecast-year shifts may require actual EPS analogs. The paper’s estimator and g mapping are unresolved.
Average daily price one month before or one month following the restatement, divided by current book value per share; the same Equation form is fit separately for pre and post inputs.

implementation_issues.description: The paper calls the Easton et al. method regression-based but does not identify the underlying estimator or variance estimator/clustering rule for the reported standard errors.

Table 4 uses current dividends per share for periods 1–4 but does not identify provider, exact current date or fiscal basis. Compustat DVPSX_F is only a candidate and is not asserted source-equivalent.

Table 4 gamma1 expression includes g, but the supplied article does not define g; no transformation is inferred. X also reinvests dividends at the estimated cost of capital, so iterative/parameter dependency details remain unresolved.

GAO ticker symbols recycle; the authors checked company names after merging to CRSP/Compustat/I/B/E/S and discarded unmatched name conflicts. The paper does not specify the exact link-vintage/sequence or manual resolution protocol.
